document_analyses.document_type: RTC / Pahani (Record of Rights, Tenancy & Crops)
document_analyses.what_is_this_document: This is an official administrative document recognized under Karnataka state revenue and municipal regulations.
document_analyses.why_is_it_important: Crucial for establishing lawful status, claiming government scheme benefits, or verifying property encumbrances.
required_actions: Verify details on the official government portal using the link below
Ensure names match your Aadhaar card and Revenue registers
warnings: NagrikAI provides guidance. Genuine authentication requires checking the official portal.

official_verification_portal.name: Karnataka Bhoomi Land Records
official_verification_portal.procedure: Go to Bhoomi Portal -> View RTC & MR -> Select District, Taluk, Hobli, Village, and Survey Number to verify ownership and crop entries.

schemes.implementing_department: Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BCWD & Minorities Welfare Departments
schemes.description: Comprehensive financial scholarship and fee reimbursement for Karnataka students pursuing Post-Matric, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, and Postgraduate degrees.
schemes.benefits: Full/Partial Tuition Fee reimbursement, Maintenance Allowance up to ₹1,200/month, and hostel fee subsidy.
exclusion_criteria: Students already availing full financial benefits from other central or private scholarship schemes
Annual family income exceeding specified category threshold
Non-Karnataka domicile students (unless special quota permitted by GoK)
required_documents: SATS Student Number / College USN / Registration Number
RD Number of valid Caste and Income Certificate issued by Revenue Department (Nadakacheri)
Aadhaar seeded active Bank Account
College Fee Receipt & Admission Confirmation
Hostel certificate (if residing in government/private hostel)
schemes.application_process: Apply electronically on the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP). Enter Aadhaar, authenticate via OTP, link College USN and Revenue RD numbers for instant verification.

schemes.implementing_department: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
schemes.description: Empowerment financial assistance providing ₹2,000 monthly direct bank transfer to the recognized woman head of every eligible household in Karnataka.
schemes.benefits: ₹2,000 per month (₹24,000 annually) directly credited to Aadhaar-seeded bank account of the woman head of household.

additional_criteria: Must be designated as the head of family in BPL, APL, or Antyodaya ration card
Neither the woman head nor her husband may be income tax payers or GST filers

exclusion_criteria: Woman head or her husband paying Income Tax (IT Returns)
Woman head or her husband filing GST returns
Government employees or pensioners drawing state/central government pensions
required_documents: Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / APL) with applicant named as Head of Family
Applicant Aadhaar Card
Husband Aadhaar Card (if applicable)
Aadhaar-linked Bank Passbook / NPCI mapping
schemes.application_process: Apply through Seva Sindhu portal, Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centers. Free registration with biometric/OTP verification.

schemes.implementing_department: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Karnataka
schemes.description: Monthly unemployment financial allowance and skill-training support for educated Karnataka youths holding degree or diploma qualifications.
schemes.benefits: ₹3,000 per month for Degree holders; ₹1,500 per month for Diploma holders, for a maximum period of 2 years or until employment is secured.
exclusion_criteria: Employed in government, public sector, or private formal sector (covered under EPF/ESIC)
Self-employed individuals paying GST or professional tax
Students enrolled in full-time regular higher education programs after graduating
Beneficiaries who have already completed 2 years under the scheme
required_documents: Degree / Diploma Convocation or Provisional Passing Certificate
Karnataka SSLC / 10th Marks card / Domicile proof (minimum 6 years schooling in Karnataka)
Aadhaar Card
Aadhaar-seeded active Bank Account
schemes.application_process: Apply online on Seva Sindhu or via Karnataka One / Grama One. System verifies university degree credentials against Karnataka higher education repository.

schemes.implementing_department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
schemes.description: Financial assistance for Karnataka farmers growing nutricereals / millets (Ragi, Jowar, Navane, Same, Haraka, Korale, Baragu, Oodalu) to promote climate-resilient farming.
schemes.benefits: Direct financial incentive of ₹10,000 per hectare (maximum ₹20,000 up to 2 hectares) directly credited to farmer bank account.

additional_criteria: Must cultivate designated minor millets (Siri Dhanya) in Karnataka
Crop details must be recorded and verified in Karnataka Farmer Crop Survey Mobile App

exclusion_criteria: Non-landowning individuals or lands not verified in Bhoomi
Crops other than designated notified millets
Landholding exceeding upper incentive subsidy threshold (max 2 hectares)
required_documents: FRUITS Farmer Identification (FID Number)
Bhoomi RTC / Pahani showing land ownership and survey number
Crop Survey App recording confirmation of millet cultivation
Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook
schemes.application_process: Register on FRUITS portal with Bhoomi RTC. Agriculture Officer validates millet sowing via mobile crop survey data; incentive transferred via DBT.

schemes.implementing_department: Karnataka Minorities / BCWD / Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Development Corporation
schemes.description: Individual and collective irrigation borewell drilling, pump energization, and pipeline installation for small and marginal farmers belonging to SC, ST, and backward communities.
schemes.benefits: Free borewell drilling, submersible pump motor supply, electrical infrastructure, and pipeline with subsidy up to ₹4.50 Lakhs in individual / group irrigation units.

additional_criteria: Must be a small or marginal farmer owning at least 1.20 acres up to 5 acres of dry land

exclusion_criteria: Farmers possessing perennial irrigation sources or existing functional borewells
Large farmers owning more than 5 acres of irrigated agricultural land
Annual family income exceeding ₹98,000 in rural areas or ₹1,20,000 in urban areas
required_documents: Bhoomi RTC / Pahani (latest certified extract)
Small / Marginal Farmer Certificate issued by local Tahsildar / Assistant Agricultural Director
Caste and Income Certificate (RD Number from Nadakacheri)
Groundwater clearance / No-Objection Certificate from District Geologist
schemes.application_process: Apply online through Seva Sindhu or dedicated Karnataka Corporation development portals (e.g. Ambedkar or Devaraj Urs Corporation).

schemes.implementing_department: D. Devaraj Urs Backward Classes Development Corporation / KMDCL
schemes.description: Low-interest education loan assistance for eligible students from backward classes and minority communities admitted to professional courses through KEA (CET / NEET).
schemes.benefits: Loan assistance up to ₹1,00,000 to ₹5,00,000 per year at a subsidized interest rate of 2% per annum, directly paid towards college tuition fees.
exclusion_criteria: Management quota admissions without KEA (CET/NEET) counseling allotment
Annual family income exceeding ₹3.5 Lakhs per annum
Defaulters on prior state development corporation loans
required_documents: KEA Allotment Letter (CET / NEET admission slip)
10th & 12th / PUC Marks cards
Caste and Income Certificate with valid RD number
College fee structure verified by the principal
schemes.application_process: Submit application via D. Devaraj Urs Corporation portal or Seva Sindhu after receiving KEA course allotment letter.

schemes.implementing_department: Energy Department, Government of Karnataka (BESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, MESCOM, CESC)
schemes.description: Provides free domestic electricity up to 200 units per month to all residential domestic power consumers across Karnataka based on average consumption.
schemes.benefits: Zero electricity bill up to the eligible monthly entitlement limit (up to a ceiling of 200 units per month).

additional_criteria: Must hold an active domestic electricity connection Account ID in Karnataka (BESCOM/MESCOM/HESCOM/GESCOM/CESC)
One connection per Aadhaar card per household

exclusion_criteria: Commercial or industrial power connections
Average monthly usage exceeding 200 units threshold
Multiple claims registered on a single Aadhaar card
required_documents: Electricity Bill showing Consumer Account ID / Account Number
Aadhaar Card of the resident / tenant
Rental Agreement (if residing as tenant in rented premises)
schemes.application_process: Register on Seva Sindhu Gruha Jyothi portal with Electricity Consumer ID and Aadhaar. Automatic verification and billing rebate.

schemes.scheme_name: Shakthi Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
schemes.implementing_department: Transport Department, Government of Karnataka (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC)
schemes.description: Universal free bus travel for all women, girl students, and transgender individuals domicile in Karnataka across state-run ordinary and express bus services.
schemes.benefits: Free zero-fare bus ticket across BMTC, KSRTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC state transport buses within the territorial jurisdiction of Karnataka.
exclusion_criteria: Luxury, premium AC, sleeper, and inter-state bus services (e.g., Airavat, Club Class, Flybus, Rajahamsa)
Travel originating or concluding outside the territorial boundaries of Karnataka
required_documents: Any Government-issued Photo ID card showing Karnataka address (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Driving License) or Shakthi Smart Card
schemes.application_process: Present government photo ID with Karnataka address to bus conductor to receive zero-fare Shakthi ticket. Apply on Seva Sindhu for physical Shakthi Smart Card.

schemes.scheme_name: PM-KISAN (Central Govt Scheme with Karnataka FRUITS Integration)
schemes.scheme_name_kannada: ಪಿಎಂ-ಕಿಸಾನ್ ಯೋಜನೆ (ಕೇಂದ್ರ ಸರ್ಕಾರ - ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಫ್ರೂಟ್ಸ್ ಜೋಡಣೆ)
schemes.implementing_department: Ministry of Agriculture, GoI (Administered in Karnataka via Agriculture Dept & FRUITS)
schemes.description: Central Government income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments to landholding farmer families across Karnataka, verified through FRUITS and Bhoomi land records.
schemes.benefits: ₹6,000 per year credited in three four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.

additional_criteria: Must hold cultivable landholding registered in Bhoomi land records
Must complete mandatory Aadhaar e-KYC and FRUITS FID registration

exclusion_criteria: Institutional landholders
Farmer family members who paid income tax in the last assessment year
Constitutional post holders, serving/retired government officers and employees
Retired pensioners with monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more
required_documents: Karnataka FRUITS Farmer ID (FID)
Bhoomi RTC / Pahani record
Aadhaar Card with biometric/OTP e-KYC
NPCI-mapped active bank account
schemes.application_process: Farmers can register via PM-KISAN portal or via Karnataka Raitha Samparka Kendras with their Bhoomi RTC and FRUITS FID number.
